info.title: Investran: Data Extraction (Query Manager)
info.description: Flexible, query like access to Investran data using data extraction API. This API includes all the methods necessary to find reports, execute reports and get report execution results. Some of the common actions are Listing Lookups using fieldId, user defined field(udfId), Retrieving report execution status and results Canceling report execution, Finding list of reports, report by id and report by name and folder.

get.summary: Get list of lookups base on a field lookup id.
get.description: Get the list of lookup, supporting odata filtering, limited to 20 by default. The maximun number of lookup will be returned is 100. Supported odata query options 1 - $filter. Example: /lookups/30?$filter=contains(name, 'le') 2 - $orderby. Example:/lookups/30?$orderby=name desc 3 - $top. Example: /lookups/30?$top=50 4 - $skip. Example: /lookups/30?$top=50&$skip=10 Example with all supported query options:/lookups/30?$filter=contains(name, 'le')&$orderby=name&$top=20&$skip=40 Supported odata filter operators 1 - in. Note: The 'in' filter operator is only supported on property 'Id'. Is not supported on property 'Name'. Example: /lookups/30?$filter=id in (1, 2, 3) 2 - ne. Examples: No Equal by Name /lookups/30?$filter=name ne 'le101' No Equal By Id /lookups/30?$filter=id ne 101 3 - contains. The 'contains' filter operator is only supported on property 'Name'. Is not supported on property 'Id' Example: Will find lookups that contains 'le' in the name /lookups/30?$filter=contains(name, 'le') Will find lookups that contains 'le' in the name but will exclude the one with Id = 1 and Id = 2 /lookups/30?$filter=contains(name, 'le') AND Id ne 1 AND Id ne 2 Rules: 1- Using 'in' is only allow once in the filter expression and cannot be combined with another filter operator. 2- Using 'contains' is only allow once in the filter expression and can be only combined with 'ne' expressions. 3- When using 'ne', in the same filter expression, property 'Id' cannot be combined with property 'Name'.

get.description: Get reports, supporting odata filtering, limited to 20 by default. The maximun number of report can be returned is 100. When the report list returns only 1 report, columns and parameters properties will be expanded. If more than one report is returned, columns and parameters properties will be null. Supported odata query options: 1 - $filter. Example: /reports?$filter=contains(folderName, 'Partner') AND contains(name, 'Capital') 2 - $orderby. Example: /reports?$orderby=name desc 3 - $top. Example: /reports?$top=50 4 - $skip. Example: /reports?$top=50&$skip=10 Example with all supported query options: .../reports?$filter=contains(folderName, 'Partner') AND contains(name, 'Capital')&$orderby=name&$top=20&$skip=40 Supported odata query operators 1- eq. Example: /reports?$filter=name eq 'Partners Capital' AND folderName eq ' Partner Reports' 2- contains. Example: /reports?$filter=contains(folderName, 'Partner') AND contains(name, 'Capital') Note: The above query operators are the only one supported in this version.

post.summary: Create a new report execution request.
post.description: DataExtraction: Query Manager REST API support two output format: "application/json" and "application/csv". Default format is: "application/json". When requesting a report execution it can be requested either using reportId or a combination of report's name and folder's name. When passing parameters in the request, it should use the parameter name to identify the parameter. The API support multiple values on parameters. List of valid values format to be use as parameter value based on the parameter type. Text: Any character, max lenght: 4000. Example "value": "home" Numeric: Pattern: ^((-?[0-9]+)|(-?([0-9]+)?[.][0-9]+))$. Example:"value": "100.2839" Date: Format: "yyyy-mm-dd". Pattern: ([12]\d{3}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(0[1-9]|[12]\d|3[01])). Example: "value":"2000-12-31" Boolean: Accepted Values: true|false. Pattern: ^(true|false)$. Example "value": "true" Integer(Lookup): Pattern: ^(\+|-)?\d+$. Example: "value": "1020" Examples: Execute report by Id: { "reportId":123, "outputFormat":"application/csv" } Execute report by report and folder name: { "reportName":"report", "folderName":"folder", "outputFormat":"application/csv" } Execute report by Id with parameters: { "reportId":123, "outputFormat":"application/json", "parameters": [ {"name":"Text", "values":[{"value":"Home"}]}, {"name":"Numeric", "values":[{"value":"100.1"}, {"value":"1000002.23"}]}, {"name":"Date", "values":[{"value":"2020-01-01"}, {"value":"2020-02-01"}]}, {"name":"Boolean", "values":[{"value":"true"}]}, {"name":"Integer", "values":[{"value":"25"}, {"value":"125"}]} ] } Execute report by report and folder name with parameters: { "reportName":"report", "folderName":"folder", "outputFormat":"application/json", "parameters": [ {"name":"Text", "values":[{"value":"Home"}]}, {"name":"Numeric", "values":[{"value":"100.1"}, {"value":"1000002.23"}]}, {"name":"Date", "values":[{"value":"2020-01-01"}, {"value":"2020-02-01"}]}, {"name":"Boolean", "values":[{"value":"true"}]}, {"name":"Integer", "values":[{"value":"25"}, {"value":"125"}]} ] }
